connector.name: OpenAI Image
connector.registryDescription: OpenAI image generation MCP server for Model Context Protocol hosts
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-openai-image. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mindstone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key with image generation access

env.name: MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH
env.description: Workspace directory for saving generated images

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Override the default OpenAI image model identifier

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Outbound HTTP request timeout in milliseconds (max 1800000)

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_SYMLINK_ROOTS
env.description: JSON array of absolute paths the connector may read through (and write generated images through) in-workspace symlinks that resolve into them. Mirrors the host's built-in file-tool declared-Space roots. Malformed or partially-malformed values fail closed to workspace-only. Optional; standalone users omit it.
